Projects You'll Build

Real-world projects to apply your skills

Sales & Retail Analytic

Build enterprise-grade sales analytics dashboards using Excel AI, Power Query, and advanced visualization techniques. Analyze real e-commerce datasets, automate reporting workflows, and generate actionable business insights through comprehensive Myntra sales and retail analytics projects.

SQL Food Delivery Analysis

Master advanced SQL by analyzing real-world food delivery datasets using joins, CTEs, window functions, and aggregations. Build business-ready reports that uncover customer behavior, restaurant performance, delivery efficiency, and revenue optimization insights.

Flight Price Analyzers

Develop an end-to-end flight price analytics solution by performing data cleaning, recursive CTE analysis, advanced SQL querying, and trend identification. Generate meaningful insights to evaluate pricing strategies, seasonal demand, and airline performance effectively.

Pandas Airbnb & IMDB Analysis

Leverage Python Pandas to transform, clean, and analyze large Airbnb and IMDB datasets using groupby, aggregation, filtering, and feature engineering. Build insightful analytical reports that support data-driven business decisions and performance evaluation.

Automated Python EDA

Perform AI-assisted Exploratory Data Analysis on real-world datasets including Titanic, Netflix, and Global GDP. Automate data cleaning, statistical profiling, visualization, and feature exploration to rapidly uncover trends, anomalies, and valuable business insights.

Power BI Sentiment Dashboard

Design an interactive Power BI dashboard using advanced DAX, data modeling, and visualization techniques to analyze customer sentiment. Build executive-ready reports that transform raw feedback into actionable insights for strategic business decision-making and performance tracking.

Course Syllabus

Complete Data Analytics with AI
AI Toolkit for Developers

Week 1: Excel Fundamentals and Advanced Dashboards

Day 1: Introduction to Excel for Data Analysis

  • Overview of Excel interface
  • Navigating sheets efficiently
  • Math & statistical functions
  • Logical functions
  • Text functions for manipulation
  • Lookup Functions ( VLOOKUP , HLOOKUP , XLOOKUP )

Day 2: Advanced Formulas & Dashboards Using Excel

  • INDEX MATCH
  • SUMIF, COUNTIFS, Nested Functions
  • Power Query: Import, Transform, Merge, Append
  • Pivot tables from multiple sources
  • Dynamic Dashboards
  • Slicers, Combo Charts, Layout Optimization

Week 2: Excel AI and Introduction to SQL

Day 1: Copilot with Excel

  • Excel AI Integration
  • Project: Sales Data Analysis (Recorded)
  • Project: Myntra Analysis (Live)

Day 2: Introduction to SQL

  • Overview of SQL & databases
  • Types of Commands ( DDL ,DML ,DQL ,DCL ,TCL)
  • Creating & Modifying tables (CREATE/ALTER)
  • Understanding Constraints

Week 3: SQL Aggregations and Joins

Day 1: Aggregations & GROUP BY

  • Aggregate Functions
  • Filtering Aggregates
  • GROUP BY vs HAVING
  • ORDER BY, LIMIT and OFFSET
  • DISTINCT vs UNIQUE

Day 2: Joins & Subqueries

  • Introduction to Joins
  • INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL OUTER & Self join
  • Deep Dive into Joins & Subquery Logic
  • Subqueries
  • Project: Restaurant Data Analysis (Recorded)
  • Project: Swiggy Analysis (Live)

Week 4: Advanced SQL and Data Cleaning

Day 1: Window Functions

  • Understanding Windows Functions
  • Rank functions (ROW_NUMBER(), RANK(), DENSE_RANK(), PARTITION BY)
  • Advanced window functions (LAG(), LEAD(), SUM() OVER(), AVG() OVER())
  • AI error detection in analytical SQL

Day 2: Data Cleaning & Recursive CTE's

  • CTE ,SUBSTRING, LENGTH, TRIM, REPLACE
  • UPPER/LOWER
  • DATE_ADD, DATEDIFF, EXTRACT
  • Project : Book Data / Flight Price Analysis (Live)
Read more

1: The AI Toolkit & Developer Setup

  • Map of AI tools: LLMs, code assistants, AI search, agents
  • Tool categories: chat models, IDE copilots, CLI agents
  • Evaluation framework: accuracy, context window, cost, latency
  • When AI helps vs. when it hurts: real limitations
  • Setting up an AI-powered dev environment in 30 minutes
  • Live experiment: solving the same problem with multiple tools

2: Prompt Engineering & Vibe Coding

  • Vibe coding: natural language to code (fast prototyping)
  • Anatomy of a developer prompt: role, context, task, constraints
  • Zero-shot to few-shot escalation strategy
  • Chain-of-thought prompting for better reasoning
  • Iterative prompting and fixing hallucinations

3: Spec-Driven Development with AI

  • Transition from prompts to structured specifications
  • Writing clear technical specs before code generation
  • Few-shot prompting with real codebase patterns
  • Generating reliable code aligned with requirements
  • Reducing ambiguity and improving determinism

4: RAG Systems & Context-Aware AI

  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) fundamentals
  • Embeddings, vector databases, semantic search
  • Connecting AI to codebases, docs, and internal data
  • Building developer assistants using RAG
  • Limitations and failure modes of RAG systems
